title: works well until it dies - and it dies far too soon.
text:
works well until it dies - and it dies far too soon.. howdy y'all,

this fan just died on me. i bought it 2015--05 and today is 2016-10. only a tad more than a year. this is definitely not worth the money. i'm going for something like the Vornado Zippy that i bought at the same time. the Zippy is going strong, this one is dead. considering this one now costs $15 and the zippy now costs $19, the choice is pretty clear.

if you need the USB power connection, i would still recommend finding something that is either cheaper so you won't mind much when it dies, or something a tad more expensive so it will last a more reasonable amount of time.

rated a TWO since it died so soon. not rated a one since it did the job well for a tad over a year.

take care,
lee
